title: Bonger Water Pipe Adaptor
description:
Dynavap Bonger Water Pipe Adaptor
The latest silicone accessory to use with any DynaVap tip and cap combination – the Bonger Water Pipe Adapter (WPA). The Bonger connects your dry herb vaporizer to a water piece with a 10 mm and a 14 mm taper to enhance your water piece use. A shorter length stem allows the included condenser to reach the CCD, providing a constricted airflow. As the first DynaVap design without an airport, the bong adapter will compliment your water piece use for a sky high experience.
Product Features
10mm & 14mm taper
45mm length body
B tip fitment geometry
Stainless steel condenser included
Airport-less design
*Will not fit in DynaStash or SlimStash products*
**Comes with a Stainless Steel Condenser**
Available in Black and Black & Green (pattern varies).
Included
1 x Bonger (Choose Colour)
1 x Storage Container
